verdict.rationale: Expensify's own 'Ask Expensify AI anything' material says users can create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses in plain language with no clicking. It also says users can configure workspaces, build rules and fix setup mistakes by asking, and can get answers and charts about account data. That covers operating the product through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond a marketing blog post, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably the natural-language commands work.
